_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment (batch S5 Joovy). Sourced 2026-07-05. Represents the current Joovy Qool Premium; Clek lists 'Qool / New Qool'. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Joovy Qool (Qool Premium)

clekListed.clekRow: Joovy Qool / New Qool — Universal Car Seat Adapter / Maxi-Cosi/Cybex/Nuna

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: 6 mo+ in seat; from birth with bassinet or an infant car seat via adapter

safety.standards: US federal stroller standard 16 CFR 1227 / ASTM F833 (mandatory for US strollers); Clek confirms all listed strollers were tested to the applicable ASTM standards for car seats on strollers.
safety.notes: Magnetic 5-point safety harness with extra padding; leather adjustable handlebar; UPF 50+ canopy; 100% recycled fabric. Joovy does not publish a per-model JPMA certification.

specs.strollerType: modular convertible single (expandable to double/triple with a second seat/bench + adapters)

notes: Modular Qool Premium (aka New Qool) — single that expands to double/triple; reversible seat, 55 lb per seat. Fairly heavy (30.8 lb) but folds relatively compact (36.2 x 24.4 x 11.2 in). Clek Liing attaches via Joovy's Maxi-Cosi/Cybex/Nuna Qool adapter (adapter-joovy-universal-mcn); for a double, both a front (SKU 9071) and rear Maxi-Cosi/Cybex/Nuna (SKU 9092) adapter are needed. DTC price $549.90.
